lines.text: What if the Moon disappeared tonight?
At first, you would only notice the dark.
But by morning, the oceans would start to change.
The Moon's pull makes most of our tides.
Without it, they would shrink to about a third.
Over millions of years, scientists think Earth's tilt could start to wobble.
Seasons could swing from mild to extreme.
So tonight, look up. And say thanks.
